title: Chen Ji's Answer
next_chapter_hook: Just as the formless existence was about to dissipate, a faint golden rune emerged from the depths of the Tianji Record, and Mo Xiansheng's voice finally sounded in full: 'The time has come—you should see the true chessboard.'

text.content: The ancient sigh echoing from the depths of the Tianji Record reverberated through the void, as if something had been forcibly choked back. Chen Ji stood still, feeling that formless gaze pressing down on his shoulders like something tangible. The surrounding light seemed to subtly distort, as if this space was being scrutinized by some higher-dimensional existence. Mo Xiansheng's hesitation made alarm bells ring in Chen Ji's heart—if even this residual soul guardian, who knew all the truths of the Tianji Record, dared not speak easily, one could only imagine the weight of their opponent.

dialogue.content: 「Interesting.」 The voice came again, cold and vast, like ancient stars whispering, 「A mere ant who hasn't even stabilized Foundation Building dares discuss terms with me. Do you know how many cultivators a thousand times more powerful than you didn't dare utter a single word of refusal before me?」

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, carrying an indescribable nuance. He didn't answer immediately, but slowly raised his hand, his fingertips tracing invisible patterns in the air. A faint spiritual light outlined the contours of a chessboard, with him standing at its edge—not a chess piece, nor yet a chess player, precisely at the delicate zone between the two. 「The senior jokes. Though small, an ant can shake a tree; though weak, a chess piece can still turn the tables.」 His voice was calm as if discussing today's weather, 「The junior merely wishes to clarify—am I an audience member in this game, or will I be permitted to take the stage?」

dialogue.content: 「Take the stage?」 There was more playful interest in that voice, 「What makes you believe you have the qualification to take the stage? Your残缺的预言能力? Your meager Heavenly Fate? Or... your so-called arrangements?」 The last word was bitten out heavily, carrying naked mockery, 「Your petty squabbles among the three major sects are nothing but children building sandcastles in my eyes—the tide comes, and nothing remains.」

text.content: Chen Ji didn't lose his temper. He even nodded, as if completely agreeing with this assessment. 「The senior speaks truly.」 His tone was excessively sincere, 「I am indeed very weak, my arrangements are indeed full of holes. But—」 His words took a sharp turn, a gleam of light flickering in his eyes, 「Since the senior is willing to waste time talking with me here instead of directly erasing this 'ant,' it means I have at least some value, doesn't it?」

dialogue.content: The pressure in the void suddenly intensified. Chen Ji felt his bones creaking. But he didn't retreat; instead, he raised his head to meet that oppressive aura. 「I猜测，前辈需要的不只是一个听话的棋子——那样的人前辈手中多的是。前辈需要的是一个能看穿三息之外的人，一个能在乱局中走出前辈预料之外棋路的人。」

text.content: 「And I, happen to be just such a person.」 When Chen Ji said this, his tone was plain as if stating an undeniable fact. His right hand was hidden behind his back, fingertips gently rubbing the cover of the Tianji Record—where Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was trembling slightly, seemingly warning him of something, yet also seemingly anticipating something. 「So my condition is simple: I want to be the chess player, not a chess piece. The senior may treat me as a special chess piece—one with its own will, capable of judging the situation independently. But the moves of this piece shall be decided by myself.」

dialogue.content:
A long silence.

The oppressive aura surrounding Chen Ji lightened and intensified unpredictably, like undercurrents in the deep sea. When that voice sounded again, the mocking tone had faded considerably, replaced by an almost scrutinizing seriousness.

「Bold and intelligent.」 The voice said, 「But do you know the difference between a chess player and a chess piece—the chess player bears the weight of the entire game. Are you certain you can bear it?」

text.content: Chen Ji laughed. This time it was a real laugh, carrying a carefree boldness of someone with nothing left to lose. 「Senior, I was already bearing it. From the moment I picked up the Tianji Record, I was bearing it. The only difference is that before, I was carrying it blindfolded—now—」 He raised his head, gazing directly at some invisible point in the void, 「At least I know what I'm carrying.」

choice.prompt: Facing this existence beyond imagination, Chen Ji needed to give a sufficiently powerful answer—this answer would determine his starting position in this game of power.

choices.description: Clearly stating that one neither pledges allegiance nor stands as an enemy, only acting as a third-party chess player independent of all powers.
choices.visible_cost: The possibility of losing a powerful backing
choices.visible_reward: Gaining complete autonomous decision-making power, with status and position directly elevated
choices.risk_hint: Potentially enrage this existence completely, facing unknown risks

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and the spiritual energy around him began to flow in a peculiar way. It wasn't confrontation, but resonance—he tried to achieve some kind of equal resonance with this transcendent existence. 「My answer is—」 His voice wasn't loud, but every word was clear, 「I will be no one's chess piece. I will only be my own chess player.」

dialogue.content: The void trembled. That voice fell silent for a full ten breaths before speaking again, this time carrying an unexpected emotion from Chen Ji—appreciation. 「Good. Very good. It has been long since I have encountered someone daring to speak to me in such a manner.」

choices.description: 表面上接受棋手地位，但争取最大程度的自主权，以合作为筹码换取实际利益。
choices.visible_cost: 需要承认对方的优势地位
choices.visible_reward: 获得天机录相关增益、情报支持或资源倾斜
choices.risk_hint: 可能被对方看穿意图，后续翻盘难度增加

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, assuming a humble posture, but his words concealed sharp edges beneath. 「The senior is above, how would the junior dare speak of independence. However—」 His words took a turn, 「The junior does have some small conditions. If the senior would agree, the junior is willing to share the senior's burdens, and in certain... areas where the senior finds it inconvenient to act personally,替前辈走几步棋。」

dialogue.content: "Oh?" The voice carried a hint of interest. "Speak then. Let me see what audacity you have, little ant, to make such outrageous demands."

choices.description: Directly declare hostile stance, challenge this transcendent existence, display an unwavering spirit of defiance.
choices.visible_cost: Immediately become the target of all, possibly inviting joint suppression from multiple forces.
choices.visible_reward: Forge an indomitable image, gaining special reputation among certain factions.
choices.risk_hint: A vast disparity in strength exists, extremely likely to be crushed on the spot.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned cold and sharp. He slowly straightened his body, an unyielding aura faintly rising around him. "The senior speaks truly. I am indeed weak." His voice was low, yet carried a metallic resonance. "But a weak person's dignity should not be trampled upon by the strong. If the senior wishes to destroy me, go ahead—but asking me to grovel? I'm afraid that's impossible."

dialogue.content: The temperature in the void plummeted dozens of degrees. That oppressive pressure crushed down like a mountain, and Chen Ji felt his internal organs shifting out of place. Yet he didn't bend his knees; instead, he gritted his teeth and endured. "If the senior wanted to kill me, why wait until today?" He forced these words out with difficulty. "Me being alive... is still useful to the senior."

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips continued drawing chessboard patterns in the air, each line clear and resolute. He could sense the other party was evaluating him, that gaze seemingly wanting to see through him completely. Yet he felt no fear—from the moment he transmigrated to this world, he had grown accustomed to being underestimated. Waste, servant, ant... he had heard these labels far too many times. What he truly cared about was never the labels themselves, but the opportunities hidden behind them.

dialogue.content: "You're quite clever." The voice finally relented, though still carrying a hint of scrutiny. "You know how to use leverage and when to show weakness before the strong. But clever people often die the fastest—because they always think they can scheme against everything." After a pause, the voice added, "Including scheming against me."

text.content: Chen Ji met that formless gaze with composure, a faint smile curving his lips. "The senior speaks truly." His voice was neither servile nor arrogant. "Therefore, this junior never intended to scheme against the senior. This junior merely wishes... to secure a position on the senior's chessboard. A position where this junior can place pieces according to my own will. As for who ultimately wins or loses this game—" He paused slightly, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes. "That can only be determined when the game concludes."

dialogue.content:
"Hahaha!"

The laughter exploded in the void, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache, yet dispersing some of the heavy atmosphere. When the laughter ceased, the voice spoke again, but much of its scrutiny and arrogance had faded, replaced by something approaching equal recognition.

"Interesting. Since the Tianji Record appeared, you're the second person to dare speak such words to me." The voice paused. "The first person who spoke these words died a very long time ago."

choice.prompt: The other party's attitude seemed to soften, and Chen Ji needed to add fuel to the fire at this crucial moment to further consolidate his negotiating advantage.

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, propose specific and feasible cooperation plans, demonstrate one's value and sincerity.
choices.visible_reward: Gain substantial support or resource commitment from the other party
choices.risk_hint: The plan may be rejected or subject to harsh conditions

text.content: Chen Ji didn't ask who the first person was. He knew some things shouldn't be inquired about, at least not now. He chose to bring the topic back to the present. "Since the senior is willing to listen to what this junior has to say, this junior dares to propose a few conditions." He raised three fingers. "First, my actions are decided by myself; the senior may provide advice but cannot directly intervene. Second, regarding the secrets of the Tianji Record, the senior cannot conceal them from me—at the very least, cannot hide key information affecting my survival. Third..."

dialogue.content: Before he could finish, the voice interrupted him. "Do you know what you're asking?" The tone was calm, yet sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine. "Wanting me not to hide things from you? Do you know that those who know too much often die the earliest?"

choices.description: Not rushing to reveal all cards, but probing what conditions the other party is willing to offer, taking control of the initiative.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the other party's intentions
choices.risk_hint: The other party may lose patience

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, assuming a thoughtful posture. "Since Senior says that I am the second person to speak such words, then I dare to guess—perhaps Senior has been waiting for such a person." He didn't directly propose conditions, but asked in return, "I only wish to know—what is Senior willing to pay for this person?"

dialogue.content: The atmosphere in the void subtly stagnated. After a moment, the voice let out a meaningful chuckle. "Interesting. Passing the ball back?" The laughter carried more appreciation, "Very well, since you've asked, I shall give you a chance—tell me what you want. As long as it's not too excessive, I can agree."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's heart tightened slightly, but his expression remained unchanged. He was well aware that when a being claiming control over Heavenly Secrets was willing to 'agree' to something, this itself was a form of probing. In that instant, he weighed the pros and cons—acceptance meant being bound, while refusal might cause him to miss a golden opportunity. The wisest approach was to transform this promise into the most advantageous chip for himself.

dialogue.content: "Since Senior has spoken so generously, I shall not decline." Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then raised his head. "I desire three things—First, the speed at which the Tianji Record is unsealed shall be under my control; Senior shall not forcibly catalyze it. Second, the safety of those I care about; before I make my choice, Senior shall not harm them in the slightest. Third..." He paused, his gaze直视the void, "I wish to know what will truly happen after the Tianji Record is complete."

text.content: Each of these three conditions precisely struck at the要害. The first guaranteed he wouldn't be consumed by forced growth. The second protected his only weakness—Chen Nian and those he cherished. As for the third... that was what he truly wanted to know. What was the price of the incomplete Tianji Record? And what would be the price of completion? Why did Mo Xiansheng always stop mid-sentence? These questions lodged in his throat like fishbones, preventing peaceful sleep.

dialogue.content: "Your appetite is rather large." The voice fell silent for a long while, long enough that Chen Ji thought the other party would turn hostile. But in the end, the voice merely let out a sigh, "Very well. I agree to your terms. But remember—what I give you must one day be returned. And the way that day arrives may not be to your liking."

choice.prompt: The negotiation had reached its finale. The other party had left a profound warning, and Chen Ji needed to make his final stance.

choices.description: Accept this pact with an ordinary heart, neither questioning nor fearing, displaying great vision.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the other's respect and resource support, with elevated status
choices.risk_hint: May face irresistible costs in the future

text.content: Chen Ji clasped his hands and bowed respectfully, his posture respectful yet not servile. "Thank you, Senior, for this favor." His voice was steady, "As for what must be repaid in the future—I have survived until now not by luck, but by treating every day as my last. Whatever the cost, as long as I am alive, I will find a way to handle it."

dialogue.content: "Good." A rare note of satisfaction emerged in the voice, "You see clearer than those so-called geniuses. Remember today's words—they will come into play when you need them." As the words fell, the pressure surrounding Chen Ji receded like an ebbing tide. At the same time, a warm current flowed from deep within the Tianji Record, and Mo Xiansheng's aged voice finally spoke completely: "The time has come—you should see the true chessboard."

choices.memory_label: 与天道之眼的约定已生效

choices.description: Accept on the surface, but actually leave behind contingencies, preparing for possible confrontation in the future.
choices.visible_cost: Need to divert energy to set up contingencies
choices.visible_reward: Gain the other's promise while retaining cards for counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji bowed once more to express his gratitude, but in the instant he lowered his head, his right hand secretly formed a hidden seal within his sleeve. This was an ancient forbidden technique recorded in the Tianji Record—it could, while accepting a certain promise, leave a reverse anchor at the causal level. Once the other party attempted to break their word in the future, this anchor would become the契机 for his counterattack.

dialogue.content: The voice seemed not to detect this subtle movement, merely saying coolly: "You are very cautious, which is good. But remember—before absolute power, any petty tricks are merely self-deception." The words paused, then added, "Of course, if you truly have the ability to make these 'petty tricks' useful, then that too is your本事."

text.content: Chen Ji stood quietly in place, feeling the transcendent atmosphere around him gradually dissipate. Mo Xiansheng's voice still echoed from deep within the Tianji Record, yet in his heart, monstrous waves were churning. Today's dialogue had far exceeded his expectations—he had thought it would be a life-or-death confrontation, yet never expected it to end in such a subtle way. 'Chess Player'—he had spoken these three words himself. And that being transcending everything had actually acknowledged his ambition.

"Don't celebrate too early." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out, carrying a warning tone, "The pact with that one has always been a double-edged sword. Everything you gained today will one day be repaid manifold." Chen Ji did not answer, only quietly clenched his fists. Of course he understood this principle. From the moment he transmigrated to this world, he had understood—there is nothing free in this world. How much he could gain depended on how much he was willing to pay. And the price he was willing to pay had always been greater than others imagined.

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, that voice about to dissipate suddenly spoke again, carrying an inexplicable implication: "By the way, I nearly forgot to tell you—your sister, Chen Nian, her recent situation... is not looking good." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his fists cracking audibly. "Those from the Holy Sect always love to act smart." The voice seemed to smile, "But perhaps this is also an opportunity for you to display your ability as a 'Chess Player'—if you truly have the skill." The words fell, and the void was completely restored to calm.

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place for a long while without moving. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out from deep within the Tianji Record, carrying a sigh: "Such is that one's method—never letting you rest in peace, yet never letting you despair." Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened his eyes again, the fire of fury had been suppressed to the deepest part, replaced by a composure bordering on terrifying coldness. Chen Nian's situation is not looking good—these words were like a thorn, lodged in his heart. But he did not panic, nor did he immediately jump up to rescue her. He simply stood there quietly, rapidly arranging all the information in his mind. Holy Sect, Ye Qing, Tianqing Sect, the Three Great Sects... each thread of clues formed new chess positions in his mind. Chess Player—he had spoken these three words, and must bear the responsibility and ability of a Chess Player. "I understand." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "Then let me see how this game... should be played."
